original_description: Goldie is a design strategist for print-on-demand sellers. Analyze a bestseller to see why it sells, turn those ingredients into fresh original concepts, expand one design into a full product line, generate market-ready phrases for your niche, surface emerging trends, and map crossover niches for your shop. Goldie can also check whether a design file is print-ready. It is built to help you create original, commercially-minded designs faster.
summary_ja: オンデマンド印刷向けに商品デザインの企画・市場調査・印刷用データの確認を支援する。
limitations: 市場動向や印刷適性の判断精度・実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
